stages.name: DISPOSABLE_SCHEMA_AND_PAIR_REPLAY
actions: materialize current UnifiedDB and ClayGraph schema on disposable copies

stages.name: PROCESS_CRASH_MATRIX
stages.promotion_gate: zero lost acknowledged commits and zero unbounded phantoms

stages.name: LOGICAL_ROLLBACK_AND_LINEAGE
stages.promotion_gate: rollback and split-lineage falsifiers fail closed

stages.name: DEPLOYMENT_BOOT_NON_BYPASS
actions: make supported service entrypoint cross V4 first
prove no fallback to system SQLite/unisolated Python

stages.name: OS_CRASH_POWER_LOSS_SEPARATE_GATES
actions: design hardware/storage power-loss discriminator if required for v0.1 acceptance

stages.name: CANONICAL_MIGRATION
stages.promotion_gate: owner-authorized canonical transition plus rollback receipt

rollback.default: do not mutate canonical state before stage 6
rollback.candidate_rollback: remove candidate branch/PR and retain current main
rollback.canonical_rollback: restore verified last-known-good only when independent RecoveryFloor and lineage rules admit it; otherwise quarantine/fail closed

explicit_non_claims: disposable pair smoke is not canonical migration evidence
process crash is not power loss
successful SQLite admission is not service boot non-bypassability
two green independent runs are not one atomic whole-product run
